title: SkillSpector scan executor
description: Run SkillSpector on a skill directory and emit annotations + optional SARIF.

path.description: Reserved for future use. Currently not wired to the scan — the Nx plugin discovers all SKILL.md files via the **/SKILL.md glob in nx.json.

sarif.description: Path to write a SARIF 2.1.0 document. Leave empty to skip.

annotations.description: Emit GitHub workflow commands (inline PR annotations).

failOnError.description: Exit 1 on HIGH/CRITICAL findings. Set false to surface findings without failing.

skillspectorBin.description: Path to the skillspector binary. Default: 'skillspector' on PATH.
